actionlint: not installed; only YAML parsing and bounded structural checks performed

llm.rationale: The pattern suggests prioritizing tests for early failure feedback. In this workflow, the 'fast' job runs both 'offline tests' (pytest -m 'not slow') and 'lint and type-check' (make lint). Since linting and type-checking are typically much faster and catch syntax/type errors that would cause tests to fail anyway, I will reorder the steps to run 'Lint and type-check' before 'Run offline tests'. This provides faster feedback on code quality and structural errors before executing the test suite.

semantic_preservation: human and change-specific behavior review required
